enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Move arm. Scratch head. Shift legs. Remain still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Turn onto back. Breathe. Snore.

Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out pan. Close cabinet. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Melt butter. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Stir eggs. Turn off stove. Serve eggs onto plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Clear table. Rinse plate. Load dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to bathroom. Look in mirror. Brush hair. Put on deodorant. Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Adjust mirror. Start engine. Check mirrors. Release parking brake. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Wait. Drive. Turn left. Drive. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to nurse station. Check patient list. Pick up stethoscope. Walk to patient room 1. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Write notes. Walk to patient room 2. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Drive. Turn right. Drive. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Close cabinet. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Rinse plate. Load dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Volume up. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read book. Put down book. Pick up remote. Change channel. Volume down. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water. Put down glass. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Pick up mouthwash. Pour mouthwash. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Breathe. Turn to back. Move arm. Scratch. Remain still. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Breathe. Snore.
